profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: Remote principal software engineer with extensive healthtech experience focused on delivering value while growing teams and pushing software architecture forward.

positions.title: Principal Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
From 2016 to early 2023, I worked on a variety of teams handling aspects of athenahealth's RCM product. During this time, I established myself as an eager early adopter of new technologies from leading our internal React Center of Excellence as I pushed for the modernization of billing workflows in 2017 to embracing AWS-hosted Java Springboot microservices for a large-scale replatforming of our daily billing process generating nearly 8000 claims per minute at peak load.

In early 2023, I moved to an internal startup offering a managed care planning services to athenahealth clients. Unburdened by legacy code, my team deployed athena's first AWS EKS-hosted federated graphQL server and several Java Springboot services to support administrator curation of physical and behavioral health care plans. My role on the company-wide graphQL Stewardship Committee ensured adoption and creation of internal best practices in a new technology space.

A strategic divestment from the Care Collaboration space in late 2024 reorganized me into our Clinicals Specialties zone, where I shifted focus to enabling rapid creation and deployment of customized, LLM-supported data-gathering workflows based on healthcare questionnaires. As I explore patient- and provider-facing workflows backed by AI, I continue aiding the development and adoption of engineering best practices in this nascent area.

positions.title: Artificial Intelligence Consultant
positions.description:
Consultant on Artificial Intelligence delivery team focusing on data science, analytics, and deep learning applied to natural language domains, chatbots, and real-time video analytics. Spent several months at a top-four telecommunications firm leveraging cognitive search and automated techniques to improve the flexibility of virtual agent interactions, increasing chat volume and diverting consumers from human specialists, yielding expected savings of over $27M over several years.

Won 2018 Accenture Analytics Insights Services Q3 hackathon by focusing on a user-driven solution to data engineering, developing a college counselor dashboard to provide feedback on counseling actions to predict expected graduation rates. This counseling center was supported by a random forest model that predicted the correct graduation outcome 87% of the time and only relying on tens of features academically proven to be predictive of college success.

Left in September 2018 to pursue more development/engineering focused work.

positions.title: Lead Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Scrum Master of dev team spearheading initiative to bring legacy pages onto modern architectures using React.js and RESTful APIs, specifically client billing workflows. Actively exploring machine learning applications to aid internal workers to expedite foreign system integrations with athenaNet's internal data representations. Previous work includes developing a database engine to support scalable rule-based systems to predict outcomes from foreign-system messages, optimizing a massively distributed jobs system used to generate claims to go out the door, and various side-of-desk projects exploring machine learning applications of athenaNet's huge data stack using scikit-learn and TensorFlow. Examples include an insurance mapper using card images and a classification system to aid internal users with repetitive integrations work.

Member of Technical Staff: Aug 2016 - Jan 2018
Scrum Master: Oct 2017 - March 2018
Lead Member of Technical Staff: Feb 2018 - March 2018

positions.title: Scrum Master (Intern Team)
positions.description: Served as Scrum Master for team of three interns focused on enhancing new patient registration workflows with optical character recognition and user experience improvements, leading to a 28% improvement in workflow time. Led Agile ceremonies focused on team cohesion and process optimization, leading to project MVP delivery four weeks ahead of schedule. Additional responsibilities included technical lead reviews, career development counseling, and explorations of third-party API integrations.

projects.title: athenahealth R&D Hackathon 2021 - Asynchronous HTTP in Apache / Perl
projects.description: Winner of "Best Overall" project in a 19 team, 200+ participant hackathon for all of athenahealth R&D by demonstrating the feasability of asynchronous code execution via HTTP request in athenahealth's legacy Apache / Perl stack. By leveraging asynchronous patterns from Javascript (React, Node), the team implemented a "Promise.all()" style code path and used it to display performance gains on a notoriously slow data aggregation, cutting page load time by nearly 30%. We expect our code to pass to platform teams for robust regression testing prior to integration with our legacy codebase.

projects.title: Accenture Analytics Insights Services Q3 2018 Hackathon -- "ELS.ai"
projects.description: Data scientist on four person hackathon team tasked with teasing insights out of the Education Longitudinal Study of 2002 data set. Focused the team on product-oriented data engineering, leading early-stage ideation sessions resulting in the creation of a 'college counseling command center'. This product was supported with a custom random forest model that correctly predicted graduation outcomes 87% of the time (F2 score) given only tens of features, leading to explainable predictions in a user-friendly manner. The user focus of our solution and model performance led to us winning first place overall, the publication of an internal whitepaper, and a modest bonus for each team member.

publications.publisher: Association for Computational Linguistics (Student Research Workshop)
